name: 85331 · Cave Creek, AZ
findings: ZIP 85331 (Cave Creek) has 118 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85331 (Cave Creek) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85331 (Cave Creek) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
